## Purpose and entry points
Open Headunit is a native Android receiver for Android Auto projection, targeting tablets/phones including legacy Android devices. It accepts wired USB, wireless Wi‑Fi/Direct/hotspot/server, and self-mode connections, then renders phone-provided video/audio and relays vehicle-style input, sensors, and location. App/bootstrap entry points are `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`, `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/App.kt`, and `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/Main.kt`.

## Application lifecycle and UI shell
Activities, receivers, and services start or restore projection in response to launches, boot, USB, Bluetooth/Wi‑Fi, and external automation. The main/settings UI controls persisted operating modes and presentation; the projection surface is a separate runtime view/activity boundary.
- `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/main/MainActivity.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/app/BootCompleteReceiver.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/aap/AapProjectionActivity.kt`

## Connection orchestration
`CommManager` is the central control-plane coordinator: it tracks connection stages and selects a projection transport, managing reconnection/failure state. `AapService` owns the active Android Auto Protocol (AAP) session once a transport is established. This separates connection acquisition from protocol/media processing.
- `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/connection/CommManager.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/connection/ConnectionStageTracker.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/aap/AapService.kt`

## Transport acquisition boundary
Wired paths use Android USB accessory APIs or native libusb; projection connections abstract USB and socket-backed streams. Wireless launchers support discovery/helper modes, developer headunit server, Wi‑Fi Direct, hotspot, Bluetooth-assisted native handshake, and loopback self-mode. These ultimately provide the byte connection consumed by AAP.
- `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/connection/projection/ProjectionConnection.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/connection/usb/UsbLauncherManager.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/connection/wifi/WifiLauncherManager.kt`

## AAP protocol and secure session
The AAP layer frames, reads, routes, and writes multiplexed control, media, navigation, and input messages. Protobuf schemas/generated classes define the wire contracts. TLS/SSL is handled through Android/Conscrypt and native hooks where required; this is the security boundary between transport bytes and decoded protocol messages.
- `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/aap/AapTransport.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/aap/AapMessageHandler.kt`
- `app/src/main/proto/control.proto`

## Media pipeline and projection rendering
Incoming AAP media is split into audio/video paths. Audio decodes and plays selected streams while microphone capture is encoded/uplinked. Video fragments are assembled, decoded with platform codecs or FFmpeg HEVC fallback, then displayed through Texture, Surface, or GL projection views. Decoder recovery/backpressure policies protect session continuity.
- `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/decoder/audio/AudioDecoder.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/decoder/video/VideoDecoder.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/view/GlProjectionView.kt`

## Head-unit event uplink
Touch and key events are transformed into AAP input messages; GPS/location, navigation status, night mode, audio focus, microphone, and vehicle identity are sent as control/sensor updates. This is the interface that makes an Android device behave as a head unit rather than merely a display.
- `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/input/TouchCoordinateMapper.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/location/GpsLocationService.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/aap/AapControl.kt`

## Runtime/infrastructure
The repository is a Gradle multi-module Android project (`app` plus public intent-contract module). Primary runtime is Kotlin/Java on Android, with C/C++ JNI for USB and FFmpeg HEVC decoding, prebuilt ABI libraries, Android Bluetooth/Wi‑Fi Direct/USB/media APIs, and optional VPN behavior in the GitHub build flavor. External interoperability is Android Auto, Wireless Helper, Tasker/MacroDroid/ADB intents, and OEM/headunit hardware.
- `app/build.gradle.kts`
- `app/src/main/cpp/CMakeLists.txt`
- `contract/src/main/java/com/andrerinas/openheadunit/contract/HeadUnitIntent.kt`
